verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox or staging environment, and no test-mode API keys. The closest evidence is indirect: quickstarts run against bundled example files (a sample annual report and a sample medical intake form) on a 10,000-page free tier, and a community user reports self-hosting the official Docker image locally, both of which let you experiment without touching production sources. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test-mode credentials, documented isolation between test and production workspaces or connectors, independent corroboration of a sandbox workflow.
